title: Building with AI & Azure
user_comment: The three latest posts by publication date, with short text excerpts. Full articles are available at their URLs.

items.title: Who Decides Which MCP Tools an Agent Can Call? Registry, Gateway, Identity and Network After Ignite
items.content_text: Assign each MCP tool decision to an owner, from registry and gateway to Entra, network and runtime controls, and build a default deny baseline for Azure agents.

items.title: Your Agent SDK Carried the Payload: Hardening Agent Build Pipelines After the Mastra npm Compromise
items.content_text: The Mastra npm compromise showed what a dependency can reach at install time. Learn how to respond and harden agent builds on GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps.

items.title: Azure AI Gateway Is GA: When to Use It, When to Keep APIM, and Who Should Own It
items.content_text: Compare three ways to run Azure AI Gateway alongside API Management, with practical guidance on New Zealand residency, MCP governance, ownership and tracing.
